scores.visual_critic_note: Intentional dark theme with consistent grid layout and quiet typographic hierarchy, but the color usage scatter panel is extremely dense with indistinguishable dots and the force graph labels overlap significantly, preventing either panel from clearly communicating its data.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Correct scaleSqrt for both network nodes and color dots, zero baseline on bar chart, all scale domains are data-driven (d3.extent/d3.max), and sensible utcMonth binning — minor deduction for no key functions on foreground bar joins and fixed color chart rScale domain built once from full dataset rather than filtered subset.
scores.stress_test_note: Rendering is correctly coalesced via dirty-flag/RAF, but both brush handlers (timeline and color) run unthrottled O(N) BitFilter recomputation and Set construction on every mousemove event without debouncing.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Four linked views with a clear top-to-bottom filter→explore→browse hierarchy keeps working memory load manageable, but the color usage panel renders as an unstructured pixel field with no visible clustering or axes that anchor the eye, and the force-layout network has enough edge crossings to slow structure recognition.
